name: ts7-compat-guard
description: TypeScript 7.0 / tsgo readiness scanner with a dated readiness ledger — flags Compiler-API dependencies (until their release train actually supports TS7), scans the installed node_modules tree for bounded typescript peer ranges that exclude 7.x (catches transitive deps), detects the @typescript/typescript6 API shim in both documented layouts, removed tsconfig.json options (with exact line numbers), and behavioural advisories. Manifest/config only, no source-file scanning, no false positives. npx CLI + GitHub Action + SARIF.

scripts.build:check: npm run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist/ || (echo 'dist/ is out of date — commit the rebuilt bundle' && exit 1)

author: ts7-compat-guard contributors
